description: This file defines a PHP class 'Jjwg_MapsViewMap_Display' that extends 'SugarView'. It handles displaying a map iframe in the SuiteCRM module 'jjwg_Maps', generating a URL with request parameters, and includes JavaScript to dynamically resize the iframe. It is part of a module view aspect, responsible for rendering and interacting with a map display within the SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: Jjwg_MapsViewMap_Display
classes.description: A view class in SuiteCRM responsible for rendering a map inside an iframe, managing URL parameters, and handling iframe resizing via JavaScript.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the map iframe with dynamic URL parameters and initializes JavaScript for resize handling.
